flags.cells.retention.purgeIgnoredOnPark: default false (trim patterns only, as before); true = purge every ignored path on park
flags.bees.tmpRoot: now defaults on workstations/cloud to <data-dir>/tmp (source data_dir_default); null = off

surfaces: classifyIgnored install class, verifyParkPaths, parkPaths, parkCellWrapper

census.scope: read-only census of ~/.hive/v2/cells on the studio workstation, 2026-10-30; du -sk semantics (APFS clones counted in full), git status --ignored=matching per space

gateMedianLiveCell.method: projection from the census (bytes minus git-ignored bytes per Cell); not measured on live Cells because purge is flag-off and live Cells are never written by this track
gateMedianLiveCell.caveat: du semantics: node_modules are pnpm hard-links from the user store and CoW clones, so the physical bytes freed are lower than the du figures

before.note: node-compile-cache is Node's default compile cache in the user tmp; bees now get NODE_COMPILE_CACHE=<data-dir>/node-compile-cache and TMPDIR=<data-dir>/tmp/<bee> (bees.tmpRoot data_dir_default)

tmpdir.change: bees on this node will write TMPDIR=<data-dir>/tmp/<bee> and NODE_COMPILE_CACHE=<data-dir>/node-compile-cache; the per-bee dir is removed on bee delete, swept for released bees at boot and cleared on park
tmpdir.notProven: the inode-leak class is gone only after deploy; this track never touches the live runtime, so the after-state is for Tormod to read with the same script after a deploy

notBuilt.gitAlternates: see DEFERRED.md: .git is 7.9% of Cell bytes (median 123 MB); purge alone meets the gate
notBuilt.honeybeeOwnedPnpmStore: see DEFERRED.md: installs already hard-link from pnpm's user store on the same volume (114/118 sampled)
